snippet.title: Why Did Everyone Call Him Al-Ameen? ﷺ | Honesty Story for Kids | Islam for Little Ones
snippet.description:
Why did the people of Makkah call the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ "Al-Ameen", the trustworthy one? In this gentle animated story, little ones learn why telling the truth matters, even when it's hard, plus three simple honesty rules to practise at home.

Sources
• Sahih al-Bukhari 4770 (the call at Mount Safa): https://sunnah.com/bukhari:4770
• Sahih al-Bukhari 6094 (truthfulness leads to goodness): https://sunnah.com/bukhari:6094
• Jami' at-Tirmidhi 2315 (no lying, even to make people laugh; Hasan): https://sunnah.com/tirmidhi:2315
• Quran 9:119 (be with the truthful): https://quran.com/9/119

We never show any Prophet. All characters are faceless.
For ages 4 to 10 · Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at · Hanafi

#IslamicStoriesForKids #MuslimKids #Seerah
